sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
WhatTheyThink is a news and analysis platform covering printing technology, workflow solutions, digital embellishment, labels and packaging, and related industry developments.

Industry: Publishing & Media · Size: $50M-$250M

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: WhatTheyThink scores 27 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 100% confidence. The score is carried by company size (8/15) and event engagement (15/15). Nothing was found for application fit and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (28% similar on print, printing, digital, label); Drytac (26% similar on print, media, display, printing); ORAFOL Europe (11% similar on digital, printing, graphics, production). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
